name: Pullman Bentota Resort and Spa
desc: Set between the Bentota River and the Indian Ocean on Sri Lanka's southern coast, Pullman Bentota Resort & Spa welcomes guests with a short ferry ride across the river the start of a stay shaped by beach, river and garden. The resort offers 165 contemporary rooms and suites with garden, pool, river and ocean views, 1.5 hours from Bandaranaike International Airport and 1 hour from Galle.

name: Pullman Colombo Downtown
desc: Set in Colombo's commercial and lifestyle district, Pullman Colombo Downtown offers 219 contemporary rooms and suites alongside distinctive dining, rooftop experiences and versatile meeting and event spaces. Approximately 30 minutes from Bandaranaike International Airport and within 10 minutes of Colombo's key shopping and lifestyle destinations, the hotel places business, dining and entertainment within easy reach.
